name: MpDHFR
notes: Recombinant MpDHFR prepared as in ref 27; construct details not given. EC not given by paper (UniProt). Q70YQ6 matches the paper's Pro150 (equivalent of EcDHFR Ser148). PDB by accession and >=90% identity: 2ZZA, 3IA4, 3IA5 (all WT); 2ZZA lists V1 for M1 (RCSB alignment M1V) and is the entry the paper names (Figs. 5, 6); 3IA4/3IA5 cite 10.1002/cbic.200900367; none cites this paper.

name: EcDHFR
notes: Construct and strain not described in this paper; P0ABQ4 (strain K12). EC not given by paper (UniProt). Named residues Ile14, Gly51, Ile94, Gly121, Ser148 match P0ABQ4. Very many WT PDB entries (165 by accession) -> pdb empty; paper names 1RX2 (Fig. 5).

name: BsDHFR
notes: Gene purchased from Epoch Biolabs, pJGetit-based vector; no tag mentioned. EC not given by paper (UniProt). Paper names the organism Geobacillus stearothermophilus; no UniProtKB entry of that species has this sequence: PDB 1ZDR (BsDHFR, ref 19, Fig. 1) is SIFTS-mapped to Q5KZ26 (Geobacillus kaustophilus HTA426, GK1775; identical sequence in many Geobacillus entries, UniParc UPI0000496FC2). Numbering matches Q5KZ26 at Leu20, Ala104, Pro122, Pro129 (also Ala7, Ile14, Asn18, Leu28, Phe31, Arg44, Thr46, Ile96, Gly98, Pro107, Pro142; 11 Pro as stated); paper's 'Lys31' is Lys32 in Q5KZ26. PDB: only 1ZDR found (by Q5KZ26 and >=90% identity); RCSB alignment lists R64G (1ZDR G64 vs Q5KZ26 R64), not engineered here; the exact 1ZDR sequence is UniParc UPI00005AB3BA (incl. G. stearothermophilus strain 10), whose UniProtKB entries are all deleted; 1ZDR cites 10.1021/bi050630j, not this paper.

name: hsDHFR (hsWTDHFR)
notes: His tag with TEV site (plasmid pET21a-His-TEV-hDHFR), cleaved with TEV; purified with 1 mM folic acid. EC not given by paper (UniProt). Fig. 5 residues I17, 24-PWPPLRNE-31, F32, 62-PEKN-65 match P00374 counting Met1. Many WT PDB entries (89 by accession) -> pdb empty; paper names 4M6J (Fig. 5).

name: CbFDH (recombinant, CbFDH_iso2)
notes: pET-23a clone from N. Labrou (natural isozyme iso2), no tag mentioned. Paper gives EC 1.2.1.2; UniProt EC 1.17.1.9. A0A0A1EQY0 is identical to the 5DN9/5DNA sequence (SIFTS, 1-364) and has Leu128, Ile227, Ile354 as the paper states for its isozyme; Swiss-Prot O13437 (named in S055) differs at 11 positions incl. V128, V227, V354. 5DN9 (holo, NAD+/azide) and 5DNA (apo) cite 10.1021/acs.biochem.6b00181 (this paper); 8HTY, 8IQ7 (2023) identical sequence. Not listed: 9KA8 (355-residue FDH entity, A251P/T256P/I354V), 2FSS/2J6I (iso1 K47E/K328V).

name: CbFDH V123A
notes: Mutant of the recombinant CbFDH (expression as ref 29); no tag mentioned. Paper gives EC 1.2.1.2 and UniProt O13437; the construct (WT structure 5DN9, ref 32) matches A0A0A1EQY0 instead (O13437 differs at 11 positions); Val123 matches both. 6D4B (V123A, ternary complex with NAD+/azide) cites 10.1021/acscatal.9b03345 (this paper); RCSB lists no other difference from A0A0A1EQY0.
